protocol.selection: Rank by most official successes, fewest cumulative contact/wall attempts, lowest mean final max point error, then arm order. Only 4/4 zero-contact development success triggers five-case validation. No learner, deployed wrapper or automatic budget extension.
protocol.scope: Unlearned local-controller feasibility only, hypothetical 60-degree planar sensing, not hardware or GRU/RL acceptance.
protocol.information_boundary: Only the 9 local actor fields, fixed calibration and independent per-robot observation-derived state. Anonymous disk fit is a hypothesis, never a sensed identity/class/bearing. Original mission leader is applied separately; all followers remain local-only.
